sources.matched_hypotheses: Finite connected simple graph; all vertices gauged; genuine spanning tree; one exclusive chord per fundamental loop; invariant Haar metric and link Casimirs
sources.required_translation: Source composes paths in the opposite written order; contract signed words and exp(tT) variations determine current conventions
sources.hypothesis_challenge: The transported operator conjugation formula requires a path disjoint from its differentiated link; overlapping paths require the actual flow/sign derivation
sources.gap: No imported arbitrary-section L2 theorem, no automatic graph-domain equivalence, no conditional mobility or physical-clock matching theorem; these require direct P2 proofs
